title.narrative: Activity under preparation Honduras Investment & Project Preparation Facility (HIPPF)

description.narrative: The action establishes a multi-sector Technical Assistance Facility to support the preparation and structuring of strategic investment projects aligned with the Global Gateway Investment Agenda (GGIA) in Honduras. Over a five-year period, the facility will finance pre-feasibility and feasibility studies, environmental and social impact assessments, financial structuring and institutional capacity building in key sectors (climate resilient water and energy infrastructures, circular economy, agro-industry, etc). Implemented nationwide, the action will accelerate the maturation of a pipeline of bankable projects, thereby catalysing large-scale European public and private investment under the Team Europe Initiative ¿Green Partnership: Climate Change and Natural Resource Management¿. The expected impact is the rapid mobilisation of downstream investments, improved sustainability and inclusiveness of infrastructure, and strengthened EU visibility as the leading partner for Honduras¿ green and digital transition.
